description: This file contains a PHP class 'Total' within the Opencart admin extension controllers, specifically handling extension total functionalities such as listing, installing, and uninstalling total extension modules in the OpenCart system.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: A controller class for managing 'total' type extensions in the OpenCart admin system, providing functionalities to list, install, and uninstall total extensions, and to generate the corresponding views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method to set response output to the list of total extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates a view displaying the list of available and installed total extensions, with actions for installation, uninstallation, and editing.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a total extension, including permission checks, file existence verification, database updates, and permission assignments.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process of a total extension, including permission checks, updating database records, and calling uninstallation controllers if present.
